pose.onnx
  RTMO-t, body7, 416x416, OpenMMLab/MMPose.
  Copyright 2018-2020 Open-MMLab. All rights reserved.
  Source: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/tree/main/projects/rtmo
  License: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/blob/main/LICENSE
  Official ONNX archive: rtmo-t_8xb32-600e_body7-416x416-f48f75cb_20231219.zip
  Distributed archive entry: end2end.onnx, renamed pose.onnx without alteration.

text-det.onnx and text-rec.onnx
  English PP-OCRv3 mobile detector and PP-OCRv4 mobile recognizer.
  Upstream PaddleOCR model weights: Baidu and the PaddleOCR rights holders.
  Copyright (c) 2021 RapidAI. All rights reserved.
  PaddleOCR source: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
  PaddleOCR license: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/blob/main/LICENSE
  ONNX distribution: https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR
  Model redistribution terms: https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR#license
  RapidOCR license: https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/blob/main/LICENSE
  Pinned distribution revision: RapidAI/RapidOCR on ModelScope, v3.10.0.
  Files are renamed without alteration. Exact source URLs and SHA-256 hashes
  are included in models.json and scripts/Install-NbaCaptureModels.ps1.

AccessRelay Studio does not claim authorship or ownership of these weights.
They supply generic person/pose and text detection, not a trained NBA shot model.
